feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 14 May 2026 3:55pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 14 May 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic, with low pressure over Scandinavia.


##Wind##

North or Northwest 5 or 6 this evening and tonight, occasionally 7 at times in the west of the area at first. Then soon decreasing North or Northwest 4 or 5 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, possibly rough in the west of the area at first, then falling slight or moderate tomorrow morning.


##Weather##

Scattered showers, then fair.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers at first.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Northwest 4 or 5, gradually backing and decreasing West or Northwest 3 or 4 overnight into Saturday, then backing South or Southwest on Saturday morning and afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain and drizzle spreading from the west on Saturday.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain and drizzle later.
